devdoc.details: Each DAO gets its own isolated vault. The factory never holds funds.

params.admin: The admin address for the new vault (typically a DAO multisig)

returns.vault: The address of the newly deployed ShieldVault

devdoc.title: ShieldVaultFactory

deployVault(address).notice: Deploy a new ShieldVault for a DAO

getAllVaults().notice: Returns all vaults deployed by this factory

getVaultAt(uint256).notice: Returns a vault address by index

getVaultsByAdmin(address).notice: Returns vaults where a specific address is admin

isShieldVault(address).notice: Whether an address is a ShieldVault deployed by this factory

owner().notice: Factory owner (can update registry or pause in future versions)

registry().notice: The official Zama Wrappers Registry — shared across all deployed vaults

totalVaults().notice: Returns total number of deployed vaults

userdoc.notice: Deploys individual ShieldVault instances for DAOs and tracks them on-chain
